decisions.decision: Vantix Control Value will be a separate workflow and data model.
decisions.rationale: The promise-to-outcome lifecycle has different units, evidence, states, actions and verification requirements from Salesforce metadata governance.

decisions.decision: Only the sanitized public Governance Sentinel JSON may be used as an architectural reference.
decisions.rationale: Environment-specific exports are excluded from design and public-release work.
implications: No copied Data Table identifiers or schema

decisions.decision: The first validated run will be fully synthetic.
decisions.rationale: The complete control loop must be proven before any sandbox or live business-system action.

decisions.decision: Deterministic rules own scores, SLA and outcome status.
decisions.rationale: These values must be reproducible and must not vary with model output.
implications: AI cannot modify priority or confidence

decisions.decision: Technical access restoration and customer successful use are separate mandatory verification criteria.
decisions.rationale: A Salesforce-side state does not prove the customer achieved the expected outcome.

decisions.decision: Consequential actions require a named human decision bound to an immutable payload hash.
decisions.rationale: Human authority must apply to the exact action that executes and cannot be replayed after a change.

decisions.decision: Effort remains a human estimate and is independent of priority.
decisions.rationale: Risk/priority does not indicate implementation complexity.

assumptions.statement: The first demonstration uses only fabricated identities, records and timestamps.
Asia/Kolkata, Monday to Friday, with no synthetic holidays is the approved demonstration calendar.
The synthetic access evidence is sufficient to demonstrate the diagnosis and verification state model but not real Salesforce authorization behavior.
assumptions.validationPlan: State this limitation in the report and README.

assumptions.statement: A human approval interaction can be represented by a deterministic fixture in automated tests and by an n8n Wait/Form/Webhook step in the interactive demo.
assumptions.validationPlan: Choose the exact n8n surface during workflow design.

risks.risk: AI invents or overstates a Salesforce cause.
risks.response: Strict claims schema, evidence-reference resolution, critique and Human Review fallback.

risks.risk: A technical state is mistaken for customer outcome proof.
risks.response: Require separate system and customer verification criteria.

risks.risk: Approval is replayed after action parameters change.
risks.response: Bind decision to action ID and SHA-256 payload hash; single use and expiry.

risks.risk: Ambiguous timeout causes duplicate consequential action.
risks.response: Idempotency ledger, target-state check and human review before re-execution.

risks.risk: Portfolio language presents synthetic success as production validation.
risks.response: Synthetic flags, limitations and sanitized public-release checklist.

risks.risk: Scope expands into live remediation or commercial SaaS before the control loop works.
risks.response: Frozen MVP non-goals and gate approval before expansion.

openQuestions.question: Which exact n8n version will be the import and validation target?
Will the optional second run read synthetic Salesforce sandbox records or remain fixture-only?
Which interactive approval surface will be used in the local demo: n8n Form, Wait/Webhook callback or another local human step?
Will any optional sandbox write create only an internal task, or will all action execution remain simulated for MVP?
openQuestions.decisionPoint: After security review of the read-only run

futureEnhancements.description: Read synthetic promise/evidence records from Salesforce sandbox through an allowlisted least-privilege integration user.
futureEnhancements.prerequisite: Synthetic workflow passes all positive and negative tests.

futureEnhancements.description: Create an approved internal Salesforce remediation task with a custom External ID for idempotent upsert.
futureEnhancements.prerequisite: Separate sandbox write threat model and user approval.

futureEnhancements.description: Add governed AgileOps Guardian handoff for systemic work.
futureEnhancements.prerequisite: Versioned inter-workflow contract and joint approval policy.

futureEnhancements.description: Add stage-specific evidence requirements for additional promise types.
futureEnhancements.prerequisite: Validated new use-case and defect definitions.

futureEnhancements.description: Add time-series process reporting after sufficient real, comparable observations exist.
futureEnhancements.prerequisite: Stable definitions, representative sample and measurement-system review.

technicalDebt.description: Physical n8n persistence-table columns are not yet defined.
technicalDebt.reasonDeferred: They must follow the final workflow state transitions and not be copied from another domain.

technicalDebt.description: Business-day calculation has one frozen timezone/calendar and no holiday provider.
technicalDebt.reasonDeferred: One deterministic synthetic calendar is sufficient for the MVP.

technicalDebt.description: AI model and API route are not pinned in the foundation fixture.
technicalDebt.reasonDeferred: The fixture truthfully uses a synthetic model-output identifier; runtime model choice belongs to workflow configuration.

technicalDebt.description: No live Salesforce access-verification adapter exists.
technicalDebt.reasonDeferred: Live access changes and impersonated customer checks are outside the approved MVP.

technicalDebt.description: 8 of the 16 failure categories identified in the external Gate 2 design audit still lack a dedicated automated negative fixture (e.g. stale/conflicting evidence markers, timeout/partial failure, missing customer confirmation).
technicalDebt.reasonDeferred: The 8 highest-value categories (schema violations, false outcome, unknown action, missed SLA, unexpected route, low confidence, reused approval, mismatched payload hash) were prioritized first; the remainder are enforced in code but not yet independently fixture-tested.
technicalDebt.targetPhase: Before Gate C is considered fully test-verified
